rows.note: This is the everyday choice for putting serious effort into an activity or task.

example.english: I exert myself a lot when doing this homework.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 ne1 fan6 gung1 fo3 hou2 lok6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when deliberately using influence to affect a person, decision, or situation.

example.english: The principal can exert influence and get both sides to sit down and talk.
example.traditional: 校長可以發揮影響力，令雙方坐低傾。
example.jyutping: haau6 zoeng2 ho2 ji5 faat3 fai1 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 ling6 soeng1 fong1 co5 dai1 king1
